ranks.timing_note: Call entry to observed ACK; includes queueing, polling and instrumentation. Overlaps must not be summed as wall time.
ranks.prefix_hit_note: Any cache tier; loadback operation counts separately show Host prefix loads, not a per-request Host hit counter.
ranks.replacement_note: Host destinations assigned different keys; counts slot replacements, not all logical eviction events.
ranks.owner_note: Block IDs assigned to different request IDs; shared prefixes can also cause owner changes.
